dialogue.hail: Hail, {name}. Keep your wits about you out here. The [gnolls] have grown bold this season.
dialogue.gnolls: Mangy curs from the camp to the northeast. They raid the road and bite anyone who strays from the stones. The watch pays a bounty on [gnoll fangs].
dialogue.gnoll fangs: Bring me four gnoll fangs, pulled from pups or scouts, it matters not. Hand them to me when you have them and I'll pay you from the watch's purse. And if you go near their camp, beware [Grubnak].
dialogue.grubnak: Grubnak the Mangy, their chief. Twice the size of his kin and meaner than a cornered badger. He shows his face at the camp now and then. Don't go alone.

dialogue.hail: Move along, {name}. The [Watch] keeps the peace in Emberhold, and I'd like it kept.
dialogue.watch: We patrol the walls and the road to Greenmoor. Warden Holt holds the post at the pass. If you've a mind for honest work, he pays a bounty on [gnoll fangs].
dialogue.gnoll fangs: Not to me. Take them to Warden Holt, down the road past the gate.
dialogue.unknown: I'm on duty, {name}. Ask the Keeper at the hearth if you want stories.

dialogue.hail: Welcome to Emberhold, {name}. Warm your hands at the [hearth]. It has burned since the [Emberfall], and it will burn long after us.
dialogue.hearth: No wood feeds it and no rain drowns it. The Keepers tend it all the same. Those who fall in these lands wake beside a [bindstone], drawn back to warmth.
dialogue.emberfall: The night the sky burned, a star came down into this hollow and would not cool. The first settlers raised walls around its heat. That ember is the one before you.
dialogue.bindstone: The hearth here, and the old obelisk in Greenmoor. When you fall, you wake at the bindstone of the land you fell in. Your belongings, sadly, stay where you dropped.
dialogue.unknown: Many things are forgotten, {name}, but not that one. I don't know it.
